title: An Interview with a Teacher
text:
Carlos is a teacher at a school in Madrid. In this interview, he talks about his favourite subject, history. He became a teacher ten years ago. Every morning he arrives at school before eight.

The interviewer asks him about his students. Carlos says that they are curious and kind. He also says that his best day is when a student asks a difficult question. At the end, he gives advice to new teachers: listen more than you talk.

questions.text: How long has Carlos been a teacher?
What kind of teacher is Carlos, based on the passage?
options: He is patient and interested in his students.
He is bored with his job.

questions.text: Why does Carlos say new teachers should listen more?
options: Students can teach teachers useful things.
Teachers should never speak in class.

vocabulary.definition: a meeting where someone asks questions to find out about a person
wanting to know or learn about things
suggestions about what someone should do

paragraph_translations: Carlos es profesor en una escuela de Madrid. En esta entrevista, habla de su asignatura favorita, la historia. Se convirtió en profesor hace diez años. Todas las mañanas llega a la escuela antes de las ocho.

La entrevistadora le pregunta por sus estudiantes. Carlos dice que son curiosos y amables. También dice que su mejor día es cuando un estudiante hace una pregunta difícil. Al final, da un consejo a los profesores nuevos: escuchar más de lo que se habla.
